name: darrow-goal-loop
description: Compile bounded engineering requests and activate host-native goals

interface.longDescription: Inspect a bounded engineering request, compile an observable goal contract, select a proportionate model and effort, and activate the host's native goal mode with the narrowest supported launch boundary.
defaultPrompt: Preflight this bounded engineering request and activate it as one host-native goal.
Check which native-goal profiles and launch boundaries are ready before spending model budget.
